analysis.one_line_summary: Static Black Friday receipt-style promotion for WavyTalk Dry & Curl Duo featuring Turblow Pro and Whirlwind Curl at $149.
analysis.full_description: A static promotional banner formatted to resemble a paper shopping receipt on a crumpled paper background with dark textured purple borders and barcode stickers. The receipt advertises a Black Friday offer from WavyTalk: 'Dry & Curl Duo' containing the Turblow Pro high-speed hair dryer and Whirlwind Curl styling brush in matching pastel pink, priced at $149.00 (35% OFF, saving $79.99), with a purple circular 'TODAY ONLY' urgency sticker.

on_screen_text.text: DRY & CURL DUO Turblow Pro + Whirlwind Curl 1
